title: Agent Hosting Trade-Off Explorer
description: The learner will recommend one of three hosting options (cloud agent, self-hosted agent, school-hosted agent) for each of four scenarios and identify the deciding factor, with at least 3 of 4 scenarios fully correct.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
chapter_title: Personal Agents and the Open Study Buddy Architecture

educational.topic: Choosing where an agent is hosted
learningObjectives: The learner will recommend one of three hosting options (cloud agent, self-hosted agent, school-hosted agent) for each of four scenarios and identify the deciding factor, with at least 3 of 4 scenarios fully correct.

pedagogical.pattern: Recommend-then-justify scenarios with a comparison table revealed after commitment
misconceptionsAddressed: A cloud agent is always the best choice because it is easiest.
Hosting only affects cost, not who sees the data.
pedagogical.assessment: Mastery is 3 of 4 scenarios fully correct (option and deciding factor both correct).
pedagogical.defaultState: Opens at the first item with nothing answered; there is no animation or timer.
